findings.text: follow-on: the fragment states base as 1 failed/26 passed in 86.76 s and "both arms fail the same single id", but the base-arm log the manifest's baseline_suite names (logs/base-arm.txt) records 2 failed/25 passed in 83.97 s, the second failure being tests/test_producer_takes_new_code.py::test_a_producer_reexecutes_onto_changed_code; the manifest's own follow_ons acknowledges that second base run as a load-dependent flake, so the fragment and the manifest report different base readings for the same node, and the fragment's lint count of 11 findings is 9 when re-run with the repository's own ruff.

follow-on: the new _recreate_unlinked_registration signature is wrapped across three lines where ruff format joins it to one; ruff format --check reckon/crew/recovery.py reports 5 deviation hunks at head against 4 at base, the new hunk being this signature, which adds one finding against the repository rule that a commit adds none.

follow-on: the branch that ends a producer superseded by a replacement that has taken the path returns False and is never driven by a test, so the behaviour the function's docstring and the evidence fragment assert (a superseded producer ends rather than overwrite a seat that is no longer its own) is unverified by the reviewed node's own gate.

item_verdicts.diff: read the range commit by commit; 2116ddeff adds _recreate_unlinked_registration and its call in watch_ticker and routes the arm-time write through runs._WATCH_SEAT_HANDLES; 6ed195be4 is the evidence fragment, 74 lines, no code change.
item_verdicts.done_when: the plan done-when item this split node owns is that crew unwatch stops a producer whose registration file was deleted under it, the producer having recreated the file by its next wake-up; tests/test_producer_registration_survives_unlink.py spawns a real child producer in its own session, deletes the seat file and asserts the record is back naming the producer's pid, then calls unwatch and asserts stopped=True and the child exits; the manifest records the gate reproduced 2 passed and I reproduced 2 passed at head 6ed195be4b31c594ea7beebcaed914fa6683e3f4.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a crew watch producer whose seat record is unlinked under it recreates the record at the same path on its next wake-up so crew unwatch can find and stop it; the landed change adds reckon.crew.recovery._recreate_unlinked_registration (reckon/crew/recovery.py:8318), called at the top of watch_ticker's loop (reckon/crew/recovery.py:8433), plus the arm-time parent-pid write now going through the held seat handle (reckon/crew/recovery.py:7257).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits 2116ddeff and 6ed195be4, the gate (2 passed, EXIT=0), base and head arms, the negative control, and added-failure data; its baseline_suite names logs/base-arm.txt (2 failed, 25 passed) and after_suite names logs/head-arm.txt (1 failed, 28 passed); both arms' completed fields are true and their failure lists are readable.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff 60b808f5f3b12faf446c1c356c3da8c5fb830e92..6ed195be4b31c594ea7beebcaed914fa6683e3f4 touches only reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_producer_registration_survives_unlink.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner/registration-survives-an-unlink.html, no path outside the reviewed node's grant and no plan HTML edit.

justifications.durability: the guard demonstrably fires, the negative control removing the recreation call reddens both cases (logs/negative-control.txt, 2 failed EXIT=1), and the cases drive a real child session rather than a thread; but the docstring's superseded-producer branch (return False at reckon/crew/recovery.py:8350) has no test, and no case covers an unwatch racing the unlink before the producer's next wake-up.
justifications.evidence: the gate reproduces (2 passed at head) and both arms and the negative control are logged with readable failure lists, but the evidence fragment's base reading (1 failed/26 passed) does not match the stored logs/base-arm.txt (2 failed, 25 passed) and its lint count of 11 is 9 when re-run with the repository's own ruff.
justifications.fit: the new function reuses watch_lock_path, _write_watch_record and the runs._WATCH_SEAT_HANDLES registry, and its comments state the mechanism rather than the incident; the sole deviation is the unformatted signature.
justifications.goal_fidelity: _recreate_unlinked_registration (reckon/crew/recovery.py:8318) compares the held inode against os.stat(path), recreates and re-locks the path when it is gone, and watch_ticker calls it before the lease check (reckon/crew/recovery.py:8433) so unwatch finds the producer again; the added arm-time-handle write removes the FileNotFoundError window that could end a producer before it polled once.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff stays inside the three granted paths and names no plan, sprint or ticket label, but the new function signature adds one ruff-format deviation (base 4 hunks to head 5 in reckon/crew/recovery.py).
